svg.title: Astra edits a pretrained PPO
svg.desc: 1,276 of 146,885 checkpoint values changed. Original PPO → wall_panic_fast. 167/210 → 180/210. 167 → 180 Finishes in 210 starts. 43 → 30 Simulator collisions. 164 Both finish. 16 Gained finishes. 3 Lost finishes. 27 Both collide. Each column is one start per circuit (seeds 40101–41010).. −2.01% Mean lap time change on 164 paired finishes
